title: PBA: Magnolia seals top seed in Group B after escape act vs Rain or Shine
summary: Magnolia secured the top seed in Group B after completing an escape act against Rain or Shine, 107-103, in the PBA Season 50 Governors' Cup on Wednesday at the Ynares Center in Antipolo.
